Upload of `app-two.ds` failed with this error:

application_details: {}

Import logs from the Creator API (these contain the actual line, form, and field that failed):
[Exception Message] - null
[Exception Stacktrace] - [Ljava.lang.StackTraceElement;@332518d5

The error_line above is in the COMBINED file at the workspace root (produced by /pack), not in any individual source file. If the import logs name a specific form/field, locate the SOURCE file for that form inside the app folder and fix the named field directly. Otherwise, read `app-two.ds` around the error line to identify the failing construct, locate the corresponding SOURCE file inside the app folder (e.g. <AppFolder>/Components/<...>/Forms/<Form>.ds, <AppFolder>/Reports/<Report>.ds), and apply the fix there. Do NOT edit `app-two.ds` directly -- it is regenerated from the source files by /pack, so changes to it will be lost. After fixing, call upload_ds_file with filename "app-two.ds" to retry the upload.
